row:
Mainly cat rescue and care with other interesting stuff, too.

We are a cat rescue and sanctuary affiliated with a local charity and work in conjunction with other local and regional cat rescues and charities to re-habilitate and re-home local strays, surrenders and rescues.
Although many of our cats find forever homes, we have a few holdouts, a few strays that periodically return and new cats arriving frequently.
We also have friendly dogs who join the cats in just about everything.
They all form the channel's recurring cast and special guests found throughout our videos.

We're not the fanciest rescue channel but we're sincere, authentic and committed to providing for whoever is in need.
Join and watch as we help the cats (and a few dogs 😉) of Cyprus live the healthy, well-fed, well-loved lives they deserve.
